SUMMARY SHEET ON THE 1962 MAR 18 EARTHQUAKE (SHEET 3 OF 5)

Zijin - 93 houses collapsed _——) 6.7% of
793 heavily damaged __) total

- Some ground depressions

- Chimneys damaged

Liuxi ~ Walls cracked

Wengyuan - Some houses collapsed

- Ground depressions

Guangzhou - A few walls collapsed
